title: Generate ULIDs
summary: Generate 100 ULID strings per call with each package's default generator.
notes: Each operation returns a list of 100 new ULID strings. The task and its adapters add no cache or pre-generated pool; each ID reads the clock and draws its random part through the library's default source. The defaults differ (crypto.getRandomValues, Math.random, a clock-seeded math/rand stream that increments within a millisecond), and that is part of the figure.
